english.title: Fail to report adverse reaction to / failure of cat / dog microchip - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having identified

(A)_[an adverse reaction to]_
(B)_[the failure of]_

(C)_[cat]_
(D)_[dog]_

(E)_[reaction]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11(1) and 14(2)(d) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.
